darwin.notes: macOS 1.2.5 build 133: makes shortcut and zoom-speed hints appear immediately, sizes popup borders to their text, removes an incorrect Help link, and matches the frameless Instructions close button to Windows. Includes Project / EXACT FILES scope and search-during-analysis fixes, refreshed external-drive status, clickable shortcut-bar Instructions, REX/RX2 editing and drag export, waveform zoom, and Project Audio Export.

win32.notes: Windows 1.2.5 build 287: adds saved Always on Top, a playhead time readout that follows seeks, and an optional resume-from-stop control. Prevents duplicate app instances. Adds Honey and botanical Preview palettes, including dark Jasmine in Light mode. Restores bounded RAM/LIMIT editing: select a region from a long source and transfer it to the other Live Preview, including one with existing audio. The editable workspace remains limited to 64 MiB decoded audio.
